Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(null);
        java.util.List<String> urls = java.util.List.of("https://example.com/good1", "https://example.com/bad", "https://example.com/good2");
        var result = Crawlberg.batchScrape(engine, urls);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
